title: Denmark – Pipeline, piping, pipes, casing, tubing and related items – Supplier qualification system for Valve Supply Contracts concerning the Danish Hydrogen Backbone - 26/23313
description: The Danish Hydrogen Backbone (DHB) project is a comprehensive effort to establish a hydrogen infra-structure in Denmark, connecting planned large-scale hydrogen production in Denmark, produced from renewable energy sources such as wind and solar, with the German and European hydrogen markets. The project is part of the European hydrogen infrastructure and significantly contributes to the EU's goals of climate neutrality and reduction of greenhouse gas emissions. The full backbone is planned to extend all the way from underground storage in the northern part of Denmark (Lille Torup) to the German border (Frøslev), but a political decision has been made to initially focus on building the southern part of the system (Danish Hydrogen Pipeline – Phase 1), and thereby having this part operational by the end of 2030. The purpose of the SQS is to establish a pool of qualified Suppliers that may be invited to participate in procurements for the supply of valves required for the DHB. The SQS covers two valve qualification categories: Mainline & Large Station Ball Valves, including mainline, pipeline, large station, manual piping and process ball valves in manual and actuated configurations; and Control Valves, including General Control Valves and Critical / Severe-Service Control Valves.. Applicants may apply for one or both categories. Final quantities, sizes, pressure classes, duties and technical requirements will be specified in the individual tender documents.

title: Norway – Welfare services for the handicapped – EL-26-12 Concession contract BPA (new notice)
description: About the procurement Elverum municipality shall continue its user choice scheme for user-controlled personal assistance (BPA) and needs to enter into new concession contracts with suppliers who can provide BPA services to users in the municipality. Conceptual clarification BPA: User managed Personal Assistance services. An alternative way to organise practical assistance and training for persons with reduced functional abilities. The BPA gives persons greater opportunity to manage the services and everyday life themselves. Service concession: A concession contract is a service contract where the repayment consists either exclusively of the right to use the services or such a right together with payment and where the operational risk is transferred from the contracting authority to the tenderer, cf. the regulations on concession contracts. User choice scheme: Users will choose which tenderer they want to provide the service. The Health and Care Services Act dated 24.06.2011 no. 30: Valid from 01.01.2012. Basis for the award of BPA, together with the Patient and Use Rights Act of 02.07.1999. Procurement Briefly Elverum municipality shall continue the user choice scheme for BPA. This means that users who have decided on BPA can choose between private providers who have been granted a licence. Elverum municipality therefore invites tenderers to apply for a license for the provision of BPA services to users in the municipality. The scheme means that the municipality approves suppliers who fulfil the requirements in the competition. The users will then select a supplier from the certified suppliers. The concession award will mean that new contracts will be signed with suppliers of BPA. In the period June 2025 until and including May 2026 Elverum kommune has spent approx. NOK 61 million to the BPA. This equates to approx. 115,100 user hours per annum, divided between approx. 44 users. Points out, however, that the contracting authority is not bound to a specific volume, as changes in need, budget and routines can affect the total volume. About the service concession scheme The aim of the service concession scheme is to allow users of the BPA to have a real choice according to which suppliers they want to provide the services (user choice). At the same time, the scheme shall contribute to ensuring that users get the help they are entitled to in accordance with the Health and Care Services Act and the Patient and User Rights Act. A service concession scheme is an administrative award where the contracting authority sets conditions for approving tenderers. The scheme functions so that tenderers who fulfil the given service concession terms after an application are given the right to offer BPA in Elverum municipality. The operational risk is entirely on the tenderer. The remuneration consists of the right to provide the service and receive remuneration for it. The contracting authority will determine which price applies to the service, cf. the general contract terms. The following applies to the scheme: Any tenderer who fulfils the concession terms and the minimum requirements will have their application for a licence granted. A tenderer who has been granted a licence will be able to provide services to the users who choose the supplier in question through user choices. There is no purchasing obligation for Elverum municipality. The same terms apply for suppliers both in the process up to and in the actual service concession scheme. See the requirement specifications and attached tender documentation for further information.

title: Austria – Public relations services – PR-Agenturleistungen für die Austrian Business Agency (ABA)
description: Die Austrian Business Agency GmbH (ABA) ist eine gemeinnützige, der Republik Österreich unterstehende Gesellschaft zur Förderung des Wirtschafts-, Arbeits- und Filmstandortes Österreich. In ihren drei Abteilungen „INVEST in AUSTRIA“, „WORK in AUSTRIA“ und „FILM in AUSTRIA“ bewirbt die ABA den Wirtschafts-, Arbeits- und Filmstandort international und unterstützt operativ internationale Unternehmen, Fachkräfte und Filmproduzenten. Gegenstand des Vergabeverfahrens ist die Beschaffung von PR-Agenturleistungen in Los 1 „PR in Österreich“, vorrangig für ABA Corporate und WORK in AUSTRIA und Los 2 „PR international“ für INVEST in AUSTRIA, insbesondere zu den Schlüsseltechnologien abgeleitet aus der Industriestrategie Österreich 2035 sowie für FILM in AUSTRIA. Zu diesem Zweck beabsichtigt die Auftraggeberin eine Rahmenvereinbarung mit bis zu 3 RV-Partner:innen in Los 1 und mit bis zu 5 RV-Partner:innen in Los 2 für jeweils vier Jahre abzuschließen. Die Rahmenvereinbarung kann von der Auftraggeberin einmal um ein weiteres Jahr verlängert werden (Verlängerungsoption). Insgesamt beträgt die Gesamtlaufzeit daher maximal fünf Jahre (4+1). Nähere Informationen siehe Teilnahmeunterlagen. // ENGLISH: The Austrian Business Agency GmbH (ABA) is a non-profit company under the authority of the Republic of Austria for the promotion of Austria as a business, work and film location. Through its three divisions "INVEST in AUSTRIA", "WORK in AUSTRIA" and "FILM in AUSTRIA", ABA promotes Austria internationally as a business, work and film location and provides operational support to international companies, skilled workers and film producers. The subject of the procurement procedure is the procurement of PR agency services in Lot 1 "PR in Austria", primarily for ABA Corporate and WORK in AUSTRIA, and Lot 2 "PR international" for INVEST in AUSTRIA, in particular on the key technologies derived from Austria's Industrial Strategy 2035, and for FILM in AUSTRIA. For this purpose, the Contracting Authority intends to conclude a framework agreement with up to 3 framework agreement partners (FA partners) in Lot 1 and up to 5 FA partners in Lot 2, each for a term of four years. The Contracting Authority may extend the framework agreement once by a further year (extension option). The total term is therefore a maximum of five years (4+1). For further information, see the participation documents.

title: Finland – Construction work – Osallistumispyyntö: Kulttuurikeskus Stoan perusparannus ja laajennus, projektinjohtourakoitsijan hankinta
description: Hankinnan kohteena on projektinjohtourakoitsijan hankinta kulttuurikeskus Stoan perusparannuksen ja laajennuksen hankkeeseen. Urakka käsittää projektinjohtotehtävät sekä rakennus- ja talotekniset työt. Hanke toteutetaan kehitysvaiheellisena yhteistoiminnallisena projektinjohtourakkana, jossa kehitysvaiheen työ toteutetaan projektinjohtourakkasopimuksen kehitysvaiheen sopimuksella ennen varsinaisen projektinjohtourakkasopimuksen allekirjoittamista. Stoan hankkeen laajuudeksi on tarveselvityksessä arvioitu noin 18 750 brm², josta peruskorjauksen ja muutoksen osuus on noin 11 310 brm² ja laajennuksen osuus noin 7 440 brm². Tilaohjelmassa on arvioitu palvelujen tilantarpeeksi yhteensä noin 10 700 hym2. Tällä hetkellä on käynnissä kaksivaiheinen arkkitehtuurikilpailu, minkä ensimmäisessä vaiheessa tammi–toukokuu 2026) osallistujat esittävät kaupunkikuvallisen ratkaisun, laativat tilakonseptin ja kilpailuohjelman mukaiset muut tilalliset, toiminnalliset ja taloudelliset kriteerit täyttävän arkkitehtonisesti korkeatasoisen ideasuunnitelman perusparannetusta ja laajennetusta Stoan kulttuurikeskuksesta. Arkkitehtuurikilpailun 2. vaiheessa (syys–joulukuu 2026) jatkoon valitut osallistujat esittävät tarkennetun suunnitelman. Tavoitteena on, että päätös arkkitehtuurikilpailun tuloksesta tehdään 5/2027 mennessä. PJ-urakoitsija on tavoitteena valita toukokuussa 2027. Hankesuunnittelu ajoittuu helmikuusta syyskuuhun 2027, kehitysvaihe kesäkuusta 2027 marraskuuhun 2028 ja yleis- ja toteutussuunnittelu lokakuusta 2027 lokakuuhun 2028. Rakentamisen on tavoitteena käynnistyä tammikuussa 2029. Koko hankkeen rakennusajan arvioidaan olevan noin 32 kuukautta, ja tavoitteena on saada kokonaisuus valmiiksi elokuuhun 2031 mennessä. Hankinnan tarkempi sisältö sekä vertailuperusteet on kuvattu hankintailmoituksen liitteenä olevissa alustavissa tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoissa. Liiteasiakirjat löytyvät julkaisun Tarjouspalvelu-sivuilta kohdassa "Liitteet ja linkit" ilmoitetusta linkistä.

title: Finland – Stimulator – Selkäytimen takajuostestimulaattorit ja oheistarvikkeet
description: Hankinnan kohteena ovat ladattavat selkäytimen takajuostestimulaattorit oheistarvikkeineen sekä ei-ladattavat selkäytimen takajuostestimulaattorit oheistarvikkeineen. Etelä-Karjalan keskussairaalan kipupoliklinikalla asennetaan omana toimintana selkäytimen takajuostestimulaattoreita (SCS). Toimenpiteiden määrä vaihtelee vuosittain kysynnän mukaan. Vaihteluun vaikuttaa muista sairaanhoitopiireistä tähän hoitoon saapuvien potilaiden lähetteiden määrä. Vuosina 2023-2025 asennettiin yhteensä 50 uutta takajuostestimulaattoria, määrä vaihtelee vuosittain arviolta 12-25 potilaan välillä. Lisäksi laitehankintoja tehdään uusintaleikkauksiin tilanteissa, joissa laitteisto on vioittunut tai virtalähde täytyy vaihtaa uuteen. Sopimuskauden on tarkoitus alkaa 1.2.2027 ja se päättyy 31.1.2029, minkä jälkeen sopimus jatkuu toistaiseksi voimassa olevana. Sopimuksen jatkumisesta toistaiseksi voimassa olevana sopimuksena ilmoitetaan noin kuusi (6) kuukautta ennen sopimuksen päättymistä. Hankinnassa valitaan sopimuskaudelle kolme (3) kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisinta toimittajaa. Yksittäinen laite hankitaan sopimuskauden aikana siltä sopimustoimittajalta, jonka tarjoama laite on kyseisen potilaan tarpeisiin kokonaistaloudellisesti edullisin ja ominaisuuksiltaan parhaiten soveltuva. Potilaskohtaisessa arvioinnissa huomioidaan muun muassa laitteen ohjelmointiominaisuudet, potilasohjaimen käytettävyys sekä virtalähteen tyyppi (ladattava tai ei-ladattava). Tuotteen soveltuvuuden arvioi Tilaaja erikseen jokaisen potilaan kohdalla. Tuotteiden toimitusosoite on Etelä-Karjalan keskussairaala, Valto Käkelän katu 1, 53130 Lappeenranta Hankinnan kohteen tarkat kriteerit ja soveltuvuusvaatimukset tarjouspyynnössä ja sen liitteissä. Hankintayksikkö ei sitoudu määräostoihin, vaan tuotteita hankitaan tarpeen mukaan. Tarjous tulee tehdä suomen kielellä.

title: Netherlands – Construction work for university buildings – Renovatie en verduurzaming Janskerkhof 13/13A
description: Het werk betreft de renovatie en verduurzaming van de panden Janskerkhof 13, 13a en Drift 2. Deze rijksmonumenten zijn een blikvanger op de hoek van het ‘Janskerkhof’ en de ‘Drift’ en zijn gelegen midden in het historische centrum van de stad Utrecht. De panden dateren uit 1648. Sinds 2006 wordt het complex gebruikt door de Universiteit en doet het dienst als kantoorgebouw voor de medewerkers van de faculteit Geesteswetenschappen. Hoofddoel van de renovatie is de historische panden te verduurzamen en deze toekomstbestendig en weer geschikt te maken als kantoorlocatie voor de komende 20-30 jaar. circa 3.300 m2 BVO

title: ANSK-26-0089 Sceneteknikk til nytt Griegakademi i Bergen
description: Universitetet i Bergen ved Fakultet for kunst, musikk og design (KMD) er i ferd med å etablere et nytt bygg til Griegakademiet - Institutt for musikk. Bygget skal romme konsertsal, black-box, kammersal, opptaksstudio og øvings- og ensemblerom, i tillegg til kontor- og studentlokaler. Denne anskaffelsen gjelder detaljprosjektering, levering og installasjon av fullt fungerende scenetekniske løsninger som del av bygget, herunder over- og undermaskineri. For mer informasjon, se anskaffelsesdokumentene.

title: Rammeavtale Grunnarbeid
description: Sveio kommune ynsker å inngå rammeavale på grunnarbeid i samband med bygningsarbeid, trafikksikring, skilting, vegvedlikehald, vann, avløp og overvatn, samt mindre prosjekter. Det kan inngås inntil 2 rammeavtaler. Varigheit på avtalen er 2 år med opsjon på 1+1 år.

title: Avfallsbeholdere
description: Rammeavtalen omfatter leveranse av avfallsbeholdere i plast til oppsamling av restavfall, papiravfall, plastemballasje, matavfall, hageavfall, glass- og metallemballasje, smittefarlig avfall og risikoavfall til bruk i renovasjonsordningen hos oppdragsgiver. Rammeavtalen gjelder suppleringskjøp av beholdere. Med suppleringskjøp menes kjøp av beholdere som inngår i daglig drift og reservedeler til disse. Avtalen omfatter også opsjon for en større leveranse av avfallsbeholdere til Rakkestad kommune.

title: Beaverlodge Cross Connection Control Implementation Project
description: This bid solicitation cancels and supersedes previous bid solicitation number WSC-2627-149 dated October 9, 2026 with a closing of October 28, 2026 at 11 AM CST. Description: The objective of this project is to ensure the potable water supply at Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) is safe and in compliance with applicable codes and guidelines, and municipal bylaws. This project will see the implementation of recommendations from a cross connection control evaluation completed in 2025 at the Beaverlodge Research Farm located at PO BOX 29, 100038 TOWNSHIP ROAD 720, COUNTY OF GRANDE PRAIRIE, Beaverlodge, Alberta, T0H 0C0. There are approximately 35 backflow preventers to be installed in 10 buildings. Backflow preventors include 14 reduced pressure principle assemblies, 3 atmospheric vacuum breakers, 3 air gaps, 1 duel check valve assembly, 9 hose connection vacuum breakers, 3 mixing valves and 1 pressure vacuum breaker. Plumbing rearrangements may be necessary for installation, code compliance, and for implementation of drawing and specification requirements. The site will be fully occupied throughout construction. In order to minimize disruption to operations, construction will need to take into consideration the use and occupancy of the adjacent areas and incorporate phasing and scheduling activities to suit. Water shut downs will need to be coordinated with site maintenance and research staff to ensure as little disruption to the operations as possible. The work will be conducted on AAFC property and will require trades staff to obtain a reliability status security clearance prior to being on site for the work. Basis of selection: This is a two phase selection process. Bidders responding to this ITT are to submit in two phases. Phase One qualification covers only the qualifications and experience of the Bidders. Following the evaluation of Phase One submissions, Bidders will be advised of the result of the assessment of their submission and the status of the Phase Two tender. Phase Two Bidders will be provided an Invitation to Tender (ITT) for the financial evaluation in relation to the specifications and drawings. A combination of the Phase One and Phase Two submissions constitutes the final bid. Initially, Bidders are invited to submit their qualifications in the first phase of the selection procedure. Only the Phase One information asked for in the ITT is to be included in Phase One submissions, and evaluation of Phase One submissions will be carried out only on the Phase One information requested. Construction Time: The Contractor must perform and complete the Work by May 3, 2027. SOLICITATIONS MUST BE SUBMITTED TO AAFC AT: See Section 3 of the Invitation to Qualify. Qualifications must be submitted only to the Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) Bid Receiving Unit by the date and time indicated on page 1 of the Invitation to Qualify. Refer to the attached solicitation documents to obtain further information. Canada retains the right to negotiate with any supplier on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. PROCURING OFFICE: Melissa Smith, Procurement Specialist Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada Western Service Centre 300 – 2010 12th Avenue Regina, SK S4P 0M3 Telephone: 306-515-4796 E-mail address: melissa.smith3@agr.gc.ca AAFC has adopted the Integrity Regime administered by Public Services and Procurement Canada. As a result, the integrity provisions are being applied in AAFC procurement activities as outlined in this solicitation. Canada will make available Notices of Proposed Procurement (NPP), bid solicitations and related documents for download through the Government Electronic Tendering Service (GETS) at https://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/solicitation-opportunities. Canada is not responsible and will not assume any liabilities whatsoever for the information found on websites of third parties. In the event an NPP, bid solicitation or related documentation would be amended, Canada will not be sending notifications. Canada will post all amendments, including significant enquiries received and their replies, using GETS. It is the sole responsibility of the Bidder to regularly consult GETS for the most up-to-date information. Canada will not be liable for any oversight on the Bidder's part nor for notification services offered by a third party. title: Germany – Ships and boats – Marine-Hafenschlepper und flexibler Fähigkeitsträger (Navy-Tug flex) - TNW
description: Für die Deutsche Marine sind über eine Rahmenvereinbarung bis zu 20 baugleiche Hafenschlepper mit Arbeitsdeck der Klasse 724, die den Vorgaben einer anerkannten Klassifikationsgesellschaft und der deutschen Flagge entsprechen, aus einer bereits laufenden Serienproduktion neu zu beschaffen. Dabei ist über den Einsatz als reinen Schlepper hinaus eine zusätzliche Verwendung als "flexibler Fähigkeitsträger" beabsichtigt, welcher die Aufnahme von zwei ISO 20-Fuß-Standardcontainern bzw. vier ISO 10-Fuß-Containern und eine technische Seeausdauer von mindestens sieben Tagen ermöglicht. Aufgrund der aktuellen sicherheitspolitischen Lage ist zum Zwecke der Eindämmung des laufenden hybriden Krieges Russlands gegen die Bundesrepublik Deutschland und ihre Verbündeten im Nord- und Ostseeraum eine kurzfristige Beschaffung (bis 2028) erforderlich. Ziel ist es, die bei der Deutschen Marine derzeit vorhandenen sechs ca. 35 Jahre alten, nicht mehr bedarfsdeckenden Hafenschlepper der Klasse 725 zu ersetzen. Die vorgenannten Hafenschlepper werden insbesondere für die Erfüllung nachfolgender Einsatzaufgaben beschafft: • Assistenz/Bugsieren/Manövrieren von Schiffen und Booten der Marine auf Reeden und im Hafen, • Schleppen von Marineschiffen, -booten und Geräten im Hafen und im küstennahen Seegebiet, • Begleiten von Seezielschießen inkl. Transport, Ausbringen und Schleppen von Seezielen, • Aufnahme von zwei ISO 20-Fuß- Standardcontainern bzw. vier ISO 10-Fuß-Containern, • Unterstützung bei Werfterprobungen, Standproben und Kompensationsfahrten, • Eisdienst in den Häfen, • Brandbekämpfung im Hafen und auf See, • Hilfeleistung bei Gewässerverunreinigung sowie • Sicherung und Bergung von Schiffen und Booten in See.

Aufgrund der aktuellen sicherheitspolitischen Lage ist zum Zwecke der Eindämmung des laufenden hybriden Krieges Russlands gegen die Bundesrepublik Deutschland und ihre Verbündeten im Nord- und Ostseeraum eine kurzfristige Beschaffung (bis 2028) erforderlich. Ziel ist es, die bei der Deutschen Marine derzeit vorhandenen sechs ca. 35 Jahre alten, nicht mehr bedarfsdeckenden Hafenschlepper der Klasse 725 zu ersetzen. Die vorgenannten Hafenschlepper werden insbesondere für die Erfüllung nachfolgender Einsatzaufgaben beschafft: • Assistenz/Bugsieren/Manövrieren von Schiffen und Booten der Marine auf Reeden und im Hafen, • Schleppen von Marineschiffen, -booten und Geräten im Hafen und im küstennahen Seegebiet, • Begleiten von Seezielschießen inkl. Transport, Ausbringen und Schleppen von Seezielen, • Aufnahme von zwei ISO 20-Fuß- Standardcontainern bzw. vier ISO 10-Fuß-Containern, • Unterstützung bei Werfterprobungen, Standproben und Kompensationsfahrten, • Eisdienst in den Häfen, • Brandbekämpfung im Hafen und auf See, • Hilfeleistung bei Gewässerverunreinigung sowie • Sicherung und Bergung von Schiffen und Booten in See.

description: Der gegenständliche Realisierungsabschnitt gehört zum DSD Starterpaket „Durchfahrbarkeit des Skandinavien–Mittelmeer Korridors“ (Scan-Med). Die Investitionssumme für dieses Projekt wird mit ca. EUR 600,0 Mio. veranschlagt. Hiervon sind bereits ca. EUR 13,5 Mio. über einen bestehenden Vertrag abgerechnet worden. Der hier neu ausgeschriebene Versicherungsvertrag wird den bestehenden Vertrag ablösen. Es wird mit einer derzeit geplanten Bauzeit bis zum 31.12.2031 gerechnet. Der Versicherungsvertrag beginnt nach Beendigung des Ausschreibungsverfahrens mit dem Datum des Zuschlages im Anschluss an eine derzeit bestehende Vorlaufdeckung. In der Planungshaftpflichtversicherung steht eine separate Deckungssumme je Schadenfall von EUR 10.000.000 pauschal für Sach- und Vermögensschäden zur Verfügung. Die vorgenannten Summen sind dreifach maximiert. Die Extendend Maintenance im Teil Bauleistungs- und Montageversicherung beträgt 42 Monate. description: The Contracting Authority manages several churches, cemeteries and other properties, and therefore has an ongoing need for electrical supplies for operation and maintenance. The agreement will run for two (2) years from the date of signing. The Contracting Authority has an option to extend the agreement by one (1) year at a time, up to two (2) times. The maximum total term is four (4) years. An option is exercised by written notice from the Contracting Authority no later than three (3) months before the agreement expires. The agreement terminates automatically at the end of the agreement period. If all options are exercised, the expected total value of the procurement is NOK 10,000,000, with expected annual call-offs of NOK 2,500,000. The maximum contract value is NOK 15,000,000. These amounts are based on historical data.

title: Ireland – Transport equipment and auxiliary products to transportation – Supply and Delivery of One (1) 17-Seater Minibus One (1) 9-Seater Accessible Passenger Vehicle
description: Limerick Youth Service (LYS) is seeking tenders from suitably qualified and experienced motor vehicle suppliers for the supply and delivery of two passenger vehicles. The vehicles will support the delivery of youth work, educational, community development and outreach programmes across County Limerick. The successful supplier shall provide vehicles that are roadworthy, fully compliant with all relevant Irish and European legislation, and suitable for transporting staff, volunteers and Young People. 2. Scope of Requirement Limerick Youth Service invites tenders from suitably qualified suppliers for the supply and delivery of: • One (1) 17-Seater Minibus • One (1) 9-Seater Passenger Vehicle The vehicles will be used to support youth work, education programmes, recreational activities, community engagement initiatives, and transport services throughout County Limerick and the wider Mid-West region. Tenderers may submit proposals for both vehicles as a single tender package. Vehicle Requirements Lot 1: 17-Seater Minibus The proposed vehicle shall: • Be new or demonstrator with low mileage. • Accommodate a minimum of 16 passengers plus driver (17 seats in total). • Be right-hand drive. • Be fully compliant with all current Irish and EU vehicle safety and roadworthiness standards. • Have seat belts fitted to all passenger seats. • Include air conditioning and heating. • Include reversing camera and/or parking assistance systems. • Include Bluetooth connectivity and hands-free communications. • Include driver and passenger safety systems as standard. • Include manufacturer's warranty. • Be fully registered and delivered ready for use. Lot 2: 9-Seater Passenger Vehicle The proposed vehicle shall: • Be new or demonstrator with low mileage. • Accommodate 8 passengers plus driver (9 seats in total). • Be right-hand drive. • Be diesel, petrol, hybrid or fully electric. • Be fully compliant with all current Irish and EU vehicle safety and roadworthiness standards. • Include air conditioning. • Include reversing camera and/or parking assistance systems. • Include Bluetooth connectivity and hands-free communications. • Include manufacturer's warranty. • Be fully registered and delivered ready for use. Tenderers may propose equivalent or enhanced specifications where these provide additional safety, operational, environmental or value-for-money benefits.

title: North Atlantic Right Whale Density Model Outputs and Scientific Support for Entanglement Risk Assessment
description: The Department of Fisheries and Oceans Canada (DFO) has a requirement to provide scientific advice on the risks of North Atlantic right whale entanglements in non-tended fixed fishing gear to inform management decisions. The Contractor must provide customized North Atlantic Right Whale (NARW) Density Surface Model (DSM) outputs, along with scientific consultation to support DFO’s entanglement risk assessment. This includes advice on model structure, assumptions, limitations, uncertainty, interpretation, and application; participation in assessment and technical discussions; and post-assessment support. The work will involve the following: 1. Tasks 1.1 Generate Customized Density Model Outputs The Contractor must generate customized density model outputs according to the Project Authority’s requirements. 1.2 Provide Scientific Consultation The Contractor must provide scientific consultation on model assumptions, limitations, uncertainty, interpretation, and application. 1.3 Participate in Technical Meetings and Assessment Activities The Contractor must participate in a kick-off meeting, approximately one technical meeting per month, additional discussions as required, and CSAS assessment and peer review activities, as requested by the Project Authority. The CSAS assessment is currently planned for December 2027 or January 2028. 1.4 Provide Post-Assessment Support The Contractor must provide post-assessment scientific clarification and technical support, as required by the Project Authority. 2. Deliverables and Acceptance Criteria 2.1 Customized Density Model Outputs The Contractor must provide customized density model outputs for the Gulf of St. Lawrence and Cabot Strait to support the entanglement risk assessment and scenario evaluation. The outputs must include: • Weekly density estimates. • Associated standard errors for the weekly density estimates. • Summary tables and spatial products, as required. • Supporting documentation. Outputs will be provided at the original 5 km grid resolution or aggregated or transformed to DFO’s defined 10 km² hexagonal grid, as required by the Project Authority. Acceptance Criteria The deliverable will be accepted when the Project Authority confirms that the outputs: • Are provided in the agreed electronic format. • Cover the requested spatial and temporal areas. • Include weekly density estimates and associated standard errors. • Include sufficient supporting information to understand and use the outputs for the intended assessment. Delivery Date Initial outputs must be delivered no later than March 31, 2027. Revisions or supplementary outputs will be provided according to timelines established by the Project Authority in consultation with the Contractor. 2.2 Final Technical Report The Contractor must provide a final technical report documenting the density model outputs and relevant technical information to support DFO’s entanglement risk assessment. Acceptance Criteria The final technical report will be accepted when the Project Authority confirms that it has been provided in the agreed electronic format and contains the technical information required to support the assessment. Delivery Date The Contractor must submit the final technical report on or before April 30, 2028.

title: Germany – Network equipment – Rahmenvertrag Netzwerkkomponenten 2027, Verlängerung Cisco EA
description: Die Bayerischen Staatsforsten AöR betreiben eine hochverfügbare, zentral administrierte IT- und Kommunikationsinfrastruktur zur Unterstützung der Geschäfts- und Produktionsprozesse an rund 600 Standorten, Außenstellen, Rechenzentrumsstandorten und Homeoffice-Arbeitsplätzen. Die Infrastruktur umfasst lokale Netzwerke (LAN), standortübergreifende Weitverkehrsverbindungen (WAN), Netzwerksicherheitslösungen, WLAN-Infrastrukturen, Sprachkommunikationssysteme sowie zentrale Management- und Automatisierungsplattformen. Zur Sicherstellung eines sicheren, stabilen und wirtschaftlichen Betriebs werden die Netzwerkdienste zentral gesteuert, überwacht und administriert. Die Netzwerkinfrastruktur verbindet die Standorte der Auftraggeberin mit den Rechenzentren und stellt die Grundlage für den Zugriff auf Fachanwendungen, Kommunikationsdienste und digitale Geschäftsprozesse dar. Die Infrastruktur wird kontinuierlich erweitert, modernisiert und an neue technische, organisatorische und sicherheitsrelevante Anforderungen angepasst. Für die Netzwerke der Bayerischen Staatsforsten kommen ausschließlich Netzwerkkomponenten (Hardware, Software, Software-Dienste) der Fa. Cisco zum Einsatz. Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist der Abschluss eines Rahmenvertrages über die Lieferung von Netzwerkkomponenten des Herstellers Cisco einschließlich zugehöriger Software, Lizenzen, Wartungs-, Pflege-, Support- und Instandhaltungsleistungen sowie gegebenenfalls weiterer technischer Dienstleistungen. Auf Basis des Rahmenvertrages sollen bestehende Komponenten während der Vertragslaufzeit bedarfsgerecht erneuert, erweitert oder ersetzt werden. Der Rahmenvertrag dient nicht dem vollständigen Neuaufbau einer isolierten Infrastruktur, sondern der Weiterentwicklung einer bestehenden, produktiv betriebenen Netzwerklandschaft im laufenden Betrieb auf Basis von Netzwerkkomponenten. Die zu beschaffenden Leistungen müssen sich in die bestehende Systemlandschaft integrieren lassen und die Anforderungen an Interoperabilität, Informationssicherheit, Verfügbarkeit, Betriebsstabilität, Administrierbarkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit erfüllen. Besondere Bedeutung kommt dabei der Kompatibilität mit vorhandenen Netzwerk-, Sicherheits-, Management- und Automatisierungsprozessen sowie der Fähigkeit zu, den Betrieb der bestehenden Infrastruktur ohne unverhältnismäßige Umstellungs-, Migrations- oder Parallelbetriebsaufwände sicherzustellen. Der geschätzte Gesamtbedarf umfasst die sukzessive Beschaffung von Netzwerkkomponenten, Netzwerksicherheitslösungen, Softwarelizenzen sowie zugehörigen Wartungs-, Pflege-, Support- und Instandhaltungsleistungen über die vorgesehene Vertragslaufzeit. Die Leistungen werden bedarfsabhängig durch Einzelabrufe aus dem Rahmenvertrag bezogen

description: COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION FOR COMMERCIAL ITEMS This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) subpart 12.6, "Streamlined Procedures for Evaluation and Solicitation for Commercial Items," as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. All equipment must be covered by the manufacturer's warranty. � Vendor shall be an Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM), an OEM authorized dealer, an authorized distributor, or an authorized reseller for the proposed equipment/system such that OEM warranty and service are provided and maintained by the OEM. All software licensing, warranty, and service associated with the equipment/system shall be in accordance with the OEM terms and conditions � Offerors are required to submit documentation from the manufacturer stating that they are an authorized distributor for the specific items being procured. Note: Maintenance Renewals - The performance period for maintenance renewals, (software licenses, services, etc.), must begin on or after the date of contract award. The performance period cannot be back dated. If reinstatement fees are required, they must be listed on separate line items. Delivery Address: ____x____ U.S. Naval Research Laboratory 4555 Overlook Avenue, S.W. Bldg. 49 � Shipping/Receiving Code 3400 Washington, DC 20375 SUBMISSION INSTRUCTIONS: All Quoters shall submit 1 (one) copy of their technical and price quote. Include your company DUNS Number and Cage Code on your quote. All quotations shall be sent via e-mail. GOVERNMENT POINT OF CONTACT Purchasing Agent Name: James Chappell Email: james.e.chappell2.civ@us.navy.mil Please reference this combined synopsis/solicitation number on your correspondence and in the "Subject" line of your email. ALL QUESTIONS REGARDING THE SOLICITATION SHALL BE SUBMITTED VIA EMAIL. The government intends to award a purchase order as a result of this combined synopsis/solicitation that will include the terms and conditions set forth herein. Award may be made without discussions or negotiations, therefore prospective contractors should have an active registration in the System for Award Management (SAM) database (www.sam.gov) in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) Part 4.1102 and Part 52.204-7 when submitting a response to this solicitation. The Government will award a contract resulting from this solicitation to the responsible offeror whose offer conforming to the solicitation will be most advantageous to the Government, price and other factors considered. The following factors shall be used to evaluate offers: Lowest Price Technically Acceptable - Offers will be ranked lowest to highest according to price. A price analysis will be conducted to determine whether the lowest price will result from a single award or multiple awards. Based on the price analysis, the lowest price offer or multiple offers, will be forwarded to the requiring activity for technical evaluation (offer(s), in accordance with the specifications, will be deemed either technically acceptable or technically unacceptable). If the lowest price offer or offers is found technically acceptable and the pricing determined fair and reasonable by the Contracting Officer, evaluation will be deemed complete and award will be made based on the lowest price offer(s). If the lowest price offer is determined technically unacceptable, another analysis will be conducted amongst the remaining offers to determine if a single or multiple awards will provide the lowest price. The lowest price offer(s) will be sent for technical evaluation. This process is repeated in order of price until an offer or combination of offers is deemed technically acceptable and price is determined fair and reasonable. Options. When applicable, the Government will evaluate offers for award purposes by adding the total price for all options to the total price for the basic requirement. The Government may determine that an offer is unacceptable if the option prices are significantly unbalanced. Evaluation of options shall not obligate the Government to exercise the option(s). title: ZeroFox Online Threat Monitoring and Removal
description: FHFA intends to procure services from ZeroFox on a sole-source basis. These services include monitoring executive exposure and digital footprints; identifying executive and Agency impersonation; monitoring brand, domain, sentiment, and travel risks to the Agency; identifying executive-focused threat information; correlating cyber, reputational, and physical-security indicators; and supporting threat disruption and takedown. For this procurement, FHFA is utilizing simplified acquisition procedures pursuant to Revolutionary FAR Overhaul (RFO) 12.102(a). The anticipated award date is November 24, 2026. All responsible sources may submit a quotation in response to this notice, which FHFA will consider. Based on market research, FHFA was unable to identify any source other than ZeroFox capable of providing the complete, integrated combination of threat-identification, protective-monitoring, brand-protection, and threat-mitigation capabilities required by the agency.

title: Ballfield Maintenance
description: The United States Coast Guard Academy intends to solicit quotations for ballfield maintenance services at the Nitchman Field Complex in New London, Connecticut. The contractor shall provide all labor, supervision, materials, equipment, transportation, and incidentals necessary to maintain the Baseball, Softball, and track-and-field/practice soccer fields in accordance with NCAA specifications. Required services include seasonal late-winter/early-spring maintenance of the baseball and softball infields and turf areas, including scarifying, regrading, infield and warning-track material placement, lip removal, edging, rolling, turf repair, replacement and verification of home plates and pitching rubbers, baseline and mound adjustments, and bullpen and pitching-mound repairs. The contractor shall also perform June deep-tine hollow-core aeration and topdressing of all three fields. The anticipated contract consists of a one-year base period, January 1, 2027 through December 31, 2027, with four one-year option periods.

title: REKONSTRUKCE BALKONŮ
description: 1) Předmětem plnění zadávané Veřejné zakázky je odstranění havarijního stavu balkonových konstrukcí a zábradlí, a to 4 (čtyř) balkonů ve 2. NP Objektu II v areálu zadavatele na adrese Na Hranicích 674/18, 181 00 Praha 8 – Bohnice, dle požadavků uvedených v této Výzvě, v závazném návrhu smlouvy o dílo a v jejích přílohách – Příloze č. 1 Smlouvy – Položkový rozpočet (soupis prací s výkazem výměr) a Příloze č. 2 Smlouvy – Technická specifikace. 2) Předmětem plnění jsou zejména tyto činnosti: a) odstranění poškozených výplní zábradlí (pletivo, drátosklo) a poškozených prodlužovacích roštů pochozích ploch balkonů; b) odstranění původní pochozí plochy až na nosnou konstrukci balkonů; c) sanace nosné konstrukce balkonů (nad i pod) včetně nátěru kovových částí; d) provedení nové hydroizolace a povrchové úpravy pochozí plochy protiskluzovou dlažbou, včetně sanace kovového lože pro nové prodlužovací rošty a okapnice navazující na hydroizolaci; e) dodávka a montáž nových výplní zábradlí (pletivo a drátosklo v novém kovovém rámu) a prodlužovacích roštů v žárově zinkovaném provedení; f) broušení a nátěr konstrukce zábradlí a obnova nátěru fasády; g) zřízení, pronájem a odstranění lešení, zajištění přístupu na balkony výhradně z vnější strany objektu a ochrana přilehlých pokojů klientů (izolace oken a dveří proti hluku a prachu); h) demontáž a zpětná montáž sítě proti ptákům, fyzická ostraha staveniště včetně lešení v době nepřítomnosti pracovníků, průběžný a závěrečný úklid a likvidace odpadů v souladu s právními předpisy; i) předání atestů, certifikátů a prohlášení o shodě použitých materiálů a výrobků a další smlouvou vymezené požadavky na předmět plnění. j) Stavební práce budou prováděny za plného provozu pobytového zařízení sociálních služeb. Práce lze provádět pouze ve všední dny, a to v době 9:00–11:00 hod. a 14:00–16:30 hod., nedohodnou-li se smluvní strany jinak (blíže viz závazný návrh smlouvy o dílo).

Progress Review Meeting(s): Any progress review meetings will be conducted by telephone or videoconference. Final Review Meeting: All communication will take place by telephone or videoconference. Problem Statement: Challenge Statement Summary The challenge is to provide the Department of National Defense (DND) and the Canadian Army (CA) a software solution to provide an airspace common operating picture so that it can plan, deconflict, and control uncrewed aircraft system (UAS) traffic, including their use of the radio frequency (RF) spectrum, in order to ensure the safe and efficient management of UAS to enable the Canadian soldier to successfully fight and survive on the future battlefield. Details: Essential Outcomes The proposed solution must: 1. Be Windows-based. 2. Allow a user to create and store flight plans, including radio frequency requirements. 3. Have a flight plan repository (database) that stores the 4D (3D + time) trajectories and spectrum requirements of all accepted flight plans. 4. Enable integration of supplemental data services such as crewed aircraft flight plans and weather. 5. Generate an optimal 4D flight path for UAS based on specific mission goals and physical limits. 6. Be able to check new flight requests against existing flight plans, airspace constraints (no-fly zones) and RF spectrum requests to detect conflicts and resolve them (via set priorities or a human decision). 7. Generate 4D blocks of deconflicted airspace (a "tunnel" or a "box") where a UAS is permitted to fly. Additional Outcomes The proposed solution should: 1. Analyze real-time data from UASs to prevent collisions and automatically adjust flight paths for UASs in controlled airspace. 2. Check in real-time whether a UAS is following its pre-approved, deconflicted trajectory. 3. Demonstrate capacity in having its critical components produced and sourced in countries within the NATO alliance, NATO Partners or Major Non-NATO Allies. To achieve this, Offerors are requested to provide as an attachment to their proposal, a list identifying the solution's critical components, the country of production and sourcing for each component. Critical components and requested information for each Critical components are defined below: Critical components: 1. Radio 2. Ground control station (GCS) 3. On-board computer 4. Any software Requested information: i. Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM): Name of the original equipment manufacturer of the product being sourced ii. OEM URL: Provide the URL of the OEM iii. Software: Confirm if developed by Offeror or outsourced iv. Product name: Provide the OEM's product name v. Model number: Provide the OEM's model and/or version number of the product vi. Product URL: Provide the URL of the OEM product, model, and version vii. Country of origin IMPORTANT NOTE: For this challenge, kindly disregard the Attachment requirements detailed at Section D in the Web-Portal, and instead adhere to the following: - The attachment measures 8.5" by 11" with a maximum size of 10Mb. - Only the following formats will be accepted: JPG, GIF, TIF, PDF or PNG. - The attachment must be clear and legible. Note: Including an attachment is not mandatory, but forms part of the Additional Outcomes, which is scored up to 10 points. The Applicant (Offeror) acknowledges that it is within Canada's sole discretion to determine whether the attachment is removed or included in the Offer. Background & Context The CA is undergoing a generational modernization effort to address the evolving nature of technology, the changing character of conflict, and the unravelling of the geopolitical system. The transformative changes being made are conceptually described in the CA publication Inflection Point 2025. This document provides the broad context for modernization and directs the development and acquisition of key systems; in particular, it states: Key to this transformation is the integration of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning, robotics, autonomous and uncrewed systems. These capabilities will support a wide range of functions, from intelligence analysis and predictive modeling to targeting and operational execution. The CA, in recognizing this need, has purchased foreign robotics and autonomous systems of varying quality and has identified challenges purchasing systems that meet operational requirements, in particular related to cold-weather operations, and that have stable supply chains. Further, purchases have, in the past, been constrained by limited manufacturing capacity of industry partners. To address this, the Government of Canada's recently released policy Canada's Defence Industrial Strategy, emphasizes the need to develop a strong domestic industrial capacity to produce defence materiel. This policy directs the CA to seek solutions to operational problems through Canadian industry, which will both improve the CA's capability while providing the foundation of a strong defence industrial base able to scale production of quality defence material. title: Perusterveydenhuollon hoidon jatkuvuuden ammatinharjoittajamallin hankinta
description: Perusterveydenhuollon hoidon jatkuvuuden ammatinharjoittajamallin hankinta Hankinnan kohteena on yleislääkäripalveluiden hankinta ammatinharjoittajamallilla toteutettuna Pirkanmaan hyvinvointialueelle. Hankinta sisältää yhteensä neljän (4) lääkärin ostopalvelun Hatanpään sosiaali- ja terveysaseman ja Tammelakeskuksen sosiaali- ja terveysaseman alueiden omapotilaiden hoidon toteuttamiseksi. Ammatinharjoittajamallilla tuotetaan yleislääkäripalvelut kokonaisvaltaisesti hoidon jatkuvuusmallin kriteerien mukaisille omapotilaille, jotka asuvat yrittäjälääkärille osoitetun sote-aseman alueella. Yrittäjälääkäri toimii omalääkärinä, joka on hoitovastuussa omapotilaistaan. Omalääkärin työparina toimii omahoitaja. Yrittäjälääkäri toimii yhteistyössä tilaajan henkilöstön kanssa osana sote-aseman moniammatillista toimintaympäristöä. Palvelussa keskeistä ovat hoidon saatavuuden sekä hoidon jatkuvuuden parantaminen. Palvelu tuotetaan joko edellä mainituilla Tilaajan sosiaali- ja terveysasemilla tai Palveluntuottajan järjestämissä toimitiloissa. Toimitiloja koskevat sijaintivaatimukset on määritetty hankintasopimuksen liitteessä 2 Palvelukuvaus. Sopimuskausi alkaa 1.2.2027 ja on voimassa toistaiseksi. Hankinnan ennakoitu arvonlisäveroton vuosiarvo sitoumuksetta on noin 875 000 euroa. Palveluntuottajien valinta on kuvattu tarkemmin tarjouspyynnön kohdassa ”Päätöksenteon perusteet”. Hankinnan kohde ja vähimmäisvaatimukset on kuvattu tarjouspyynnössä ja tarjouspyynnön liitteissä.,
